name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Styled Solid checkbox component backed by Keystone selection-control behavior.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through mason-checkbox classes while Keystone keeps role=checkbox, mixed state, hidden input, and preventable toggle behavior.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers controlled and uncontrolled checked state, indeterminate state, disabled/read-only guards, role=checkbox, hidden input submission, user-handler precedence, and Mason wrapper metadata. Gaps: cursor/touch press behavior, richer field composition, validation edge cases, animation lifecycle data, and hydration edge tests remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Matches Solid Root/Input/Control/Indicator direction for checked and indeterminate state, hidden native input, preventable interaction, disabled/read-only state, and stable data attributes. Gaps: group composition, form-control registration depth, and broader SSR/form reset coverage remain follow-up work.
